svg.title: HOTELSCOUT — Hotel finder PWA
svg.desc: Finds real accommodation near a station, an airport or an address with OpenStreetMap data: interactive map, filters, favourites and a Booking.com search link. No accounts, no trackers, €0 running cost. Architecture: CLIENT React PWA (map · filters · favourites, own service worker) → EDGE Pages Functions (/api/* proxy · cache, rate limit · User-Agent) → DATA OpenStreetMap (Nominatim geocoding, Overpass POI queries). KEY SYSTEMS: Leaflet + MapLibre map with Spanish names worldwide; Distinct states: empty ≠ limit ≠ outage ≠ offline; Booking.com deep link — a search, never a fake price; Installable, opens offline, favourites stay local. QUALITY GATES: 85 unit + integration, 21 end-to-end, 0 axe violations, 0 npm audit. Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Leaflet, TanStack Query, Zod, Vitest, Playwright, Cloudflare Pages. Live at hotelscout.pages.dev.
